sn22.35:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3
sn22.35:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu ||
sn22.35:1.4: yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || || 4
sn22.35:1.5: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati ||
sn22.35:1.6: yaṃ nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti || ||
sn22.35:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6
sn22.35:2.2: Rūpaṃ ce bhante anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:2.3: Vedanaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:2.4: Saññaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:2.5: Saṅkhāre ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:2.6: Viññāṇam ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || || 7
sn22.35:2.7: Rūpaṃ ce bhante nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati ||
sn22.35:2.11: Viññānaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:2.12: Imassa kho ham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || || 8
sn22.35:3.2: sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || ||
sn22.35:3.3: Rūpaṃ ce bhikkhu anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:3.7: viññāṇaṃ ce anuseti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:3.8: Rūpaṃ ce bhikkhu nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:3.12: viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn22.35:3.13: Imassa kho bhikkhave saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || || 9
sn22.35:4.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 10
sn22.35:5.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahītatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjanti || tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariya-pariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || ||
sn22.35:5.2: Khīṇā jati vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam nāparam itthattāyā ti abbhaññāsi || || 11
sn22.35:5.3: Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahatam ahosīti || || 1
